deadline.value: Two rounds a year: October 31 and April 30. Next: Oct 31, 2026 (imminent) and Apr 30, 2027. Complete files incl. 3 letters. Years inferred.
deadline.quote: The deadlines for applications to the Physics Doctoral Program are April 30 and October 31 of each year.

app_fee.value: No application fee (enrolment fees apply later)
app_fee.quote: Is there an application fee? No, there is no application fees

fee_waiver.quote: Is there an application fee? No, there is no application fees

gre_general.quote: The results of the GRE general test is not required but recommended.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL strongly recommended (not mandatory) if your first language is not English or French; no minimum stated
toefl_min.quote: For foreign applicants whose first language is not English or French, we strongly recommend that they provide us with the results of the TOEFL and/or GRE test.

english_waiver.value: No English test is strictly required; proficiency in English is required and TOEFL is strongly recommended
english_waiver.quote: You must be proficient in English to pursue your doctoral studies at EPFL.

supervisor.value: Admission = eligible by committee AND a thesis advisor offers you a PhD position after interview; eligible files are shared with all thesis directors
supervisor.quote: the candidate found a thesis advisor associated with the program, in a research unit that decided, after an interview, to offer him/her a PhD student position

funding.value: Enrolment requires secured funding; lab-appointed doctoral students get an employment contract
funding.quote: The final enrollment in the doctoral program is conditional to the choice of a thesis topic, a supervisor and a secure funding.

entry_route.value: Usually after a master's; 4- or 5-year bachelor's holders may apply and should explain their education in the Statement of Objectives
entry_route.quote: Doctoral studies at EPFL usually begin after a Master’s degree in the relevant discipline. Candidates with a 4-year or 5-year Bachelor’s degree may also apply

notes: French not required to start; visas/work permits take about 3 months after appointment.
